title: Ruthless Tropic Thunda Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Treat your tastebuds to a sun-soaked island getaway with Tropic Thunda from Ruthless. Smooth, sweet and invigorating, Tropic Thunda deftly layers juicy, exotic Guava with the sharpness of ripe berries for a delicious all-day vape. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 85% VG / 15% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
